# The fixtures are flNN<letter>_<slug>.pas in harness/fixtures/fpc_ladder (a folder named in the cell for the others), each with its {$mode} line and at most 20 lines, its .ref cut twice from fpc 3.2.2
# in that mode, and its .rc when fpc ends it non-zero (fl35b ends rc 3). WHILE A FIXTURE IS A FIXTURE it is graded by its bytes and its return code:
#   scrip --run harness/fixtures/fpc_ladder/flNN_<slug>.pas < /dev/null > out; cmp out flNN_<slug>.ref, and rc equal to flNN_<slug>.rc (0 when absent)

# A fixture joins the pascal master in the landing that turns it green: python3 harness/scripts/util_add_ladder_witness.py --lang pascal --family ladder --dialect <its mode> --source <fixture> --apply
# (the entry is ladder__rungNN_<slug>, and LADDER.tsv's # PLAN-rungNN line becomes a rungNN row in the same landing).

# A RUNG IS CLOSED when every fixture of its cell reads m3_pass=1 through corpus_suite_harness.py run corpus/tests/pascal/ALL.pas corpus/tests/pascal/ALL.ref --lang pascal --modes m3 --partition entry:ladder__rungNN_<slug>
